optionDescriptions.enableCode: Inline code, as a mark rather than a block.
optionDescriptions.enableSubSup: Subscript and superscript, which are mutually exclusive.
optionDescriptions.enableColor: Text colour, with the palette from `colors`.
optionDescriptions.enableBackgroundColor: Background colour, with the same palette.
optionDescriptions.enableHeadings: Headings at the levels given by `headingLevels`.
optionDescriptions.enableAlign: Block alignment, with `left` as the canonical default (fixes R6).
optionDescriptions.enableLists: Bulleted and numbered lists, with nesting.
optionDescriptions.enableCodeBlock: Fenced code blocks with syntax highlighting.
optionDescriptions.enableLinks: Links, the link popover and URL validation.
optionDescriptions.enableImages: Images, including upload, drag-and-drop and paste.
optionDescriptions.enableEmoji: The emoji picker and its `:` trigger.
optionDescriptions.enableMentions: Mentions and their `@` trigger, configured through `mentions`.
optionDescriptions.enableMergeTags: Merge tags as atomic nodes, configured through `mergeTags` (fixes R23).
optionDescriptions.enableHistory: Undo and redo, with their bindings and toolbar controls.
optionDescriptions.enableMarkdownShortcuts: Markdown input rules, such as `# ` for a heading.
optionDescriptions.enableSourceView: The HTML source view, which sanitizes on apply.
optionDescriptions.onChange: Every content change, with the source that caused it (fixes R21).
optionDescriptions.changeDebounceMs: How long the typing has to stop before `onChangeDebounced` runs.
optionDescriptions.onBlur: Focus left the editor for something outside it (fixes R9).
optionDescriptions.onSelectionChange: The selection moved, or collapsed to nothing (fixes R8).
optionDescriptions.onReady: Fired once, when the engine has mounted.
optionDescriptions.onContentWarning: Content that was dropped or downgraded on input. A development aid.
optionDescriptions.onError: Anything the engine, a plugin or a serializer threw.
optionDescriptions.disabled: Not focusable, dimmed, `aria-disabled`. What forms should use.
optionDescriptions.readOnly: Selection and copy still work; editing does not.
optionDescriptions.autoFocus: Take focus on mount, optionally placing the caret.
optionDescriptions.placeholder: Shown over an empty document (fixes R24).
optionDescriptions.spellCheck: Browser spell-checking inside the content element.
optionDescriptions.dir: Writing direction; `rtl` mirrors the whole field, including the toolbar.
optionDescriptions.lang: The content language, for spell-checking and screen-reader pronunciation.
optionDescriptions.tabIndex: Tab order of the content element.
optionDescriptions.editorRef: Receives the EditorInstance once the engine has mounted.
optionDescriptions.preset: The plugin bundle and the props it implies.
optionDescriptions.plugins: Replaces the preset's plugin list entirely.
optionDescriptions.addPlugins: Plugins added on top of the preset's list.
optionDescriptions.removePlugins: Names of plugins the preset included that this editor does not want.
optionDescriptions.pluginOptions: Per-plugin options, keyed by plugin name.
optionDescriptions.headingLevels: Which heading levels the dropdown and the schema allow.
optionDescriptions.colors: Swatches, columns and the custom-colour option.
optionDescriptions.mergeTags: The merge tags this editor knows, and how they are triggered.
optionDescriptions.mentions: The mention provider, trigger and rendering.
optionDescriptions.markdownShortcuts: Markdown input rules, or an explicit list of them.
optionDescriptions.maxLength: Counts text in `countUnit`, never markup (fixes R3).
optionDescriptions.maxLengthBehaviour: Whether the limit refuses further input or only warns.
optionDescriptions.error: `true` sets the error state; a string also renders as the message.
optionDescriptions.helperText: Description below the field, linked with `aria-describedby` (fixes R16).
optionDescriptions.label: Renders a `<label>` bound to the content element.
optionDescriptions.validate: Returns a message for invalid content, or `null` when it is acceptable.
optionDescriptions.sanitize: The input sanitization profile, or an explicit config.
optionDescriptions.sanitizeOutput: Sanitize again on the way out, so a bug upstream cannot leak.
optionDescriptions.emailOptions: Inlining, width and table-layout choices for the `email` profile.
optionDescriptions.interop: How legacy markup, such as Quill's, is read and written back.
optionDescriptions.pasteMode: Rich, plain or cleaned paste, statically or per paste.
optionDescriptions.pastePrompt: Offer "Keep / Remove formatting" after a rich office paste.
optionDescriptions.autoLink: Turn typed URLs and e-mail addresses into links.
optionDescriptions.autoLinkProtocols: Protocols a typed URL may be linked with.
optionDescriptions.defaultProtocol: Protocol given to a bare host, in the popover and in autolinking.
optionDescriptions.linkValidator:
Rejects or rewrites a URL before it becomes a link.

Return a message to reject, or `null` to accept. Sanitization runs regardless: a
validator can tighten the rules but never loosens them.
optionDescriptions.allowDataUrlImages: Allow `data:` image sources, which bloat stored content.
optionDescriptions.autosave: Draft saving, its key, its TTL and its restore prompt.
optionDescriptions.toolbarPosition: Which side of the content the toolbar sits on.
optionDescriptions.stickyToolbar: Keep the toolbar visible while a long document scrolls.
optionDescriptions.toolbarOverflow: What happens to items that do not fit at this width.
optionDescriptions.floatingToolbar: A toolbar that follows the selection.
optionDescriptions.bubbleMenuItems: What the bubble menu offers, when it differs from the floating toolbar.
optionDescriptions.minHeight: Height of the content box before it grows.
optionDescriptions.maxHeight: Height at which the content starts scrolling instead of growing.
optionDescriptions.autoGrow: Grow with the content rather than scrolling immediately.
optionDescriptions.resizable: Offer a drag handle for resizing the content box (fixes R22).
optionDescriptions.defaultFullscreen: Start in fullscreen, for an uncontrolled editor.
optionDescriptions.footer: Extra footer content next to the counter.
optionDescriptions.readOnlyToolbar: Hide or disable the toolbar in `readOnly` mode.
optionDescriptions.renderToolbar: Replaces the toolbar, with the resolved items and the default renderer to hand.
optionDescriptions.renderImagePopover: Replaces the controls shown when an image is selected.
optionDescriptions.renderRestoreDraftPrompt: Replaces the prompt offering to restore an autosaved draft.
optionDescriptions.onUpload: Hands a file to your own service and returns the attributes to insert.
optionDescriptions.uploadAccept: Accepted file types, enforced before the upload starts.
optionDescriptions.maxUploadSize: Size ceiling, enforced before the file leaves the browser.
optionDescriptions.onUploadError: A rejected or failed upload, with the file it concerned.
optionDescriptions.imageOptions: Resizing, alignment and caption behaviour for images.
optionDescriptions.slotProps: Extra props merged into each slot, statically or per render.
optionDescriptions.handlers: Interaction middleware; each wraps one interaction.
optionDescriptions.commandOverrides: Replacement command implementations, by command id.
optionDescriptions.localization: Message catalogue, merged over the default.
optionDescriptions.theme: Theme tokens, merged over the preset's.
optionDescriptions.colorScheme: Light, dark, or follow the operating system.
optionDescriptions.unstyled: Structure and prose styles only, no chrome visuals.
optionDescriptions.id: Base for the generated element ids; one is derived when absent (fixes R4).
optionDescriptions.keymap: Extra or replacement bindings, keyed by shortcut string.
optionDescriptions.disableShortcuts: Bindings to drop, so the surrounding app can claim them.
optionDescriptions.onSubmit: Called when a submit binding fires, with the current value.
optionDescriptions.escapeExitsEditor: Let Escape move focus out of the editor.
